verdict.rationale: There's no documented first-party write API or MCP server for Claude Design itself (OpenAPI probe returned 404s), but Claude Code slash-commands (/design, /design-sync) and handoff bundles let an agent programmatically create/modify designs, and one community report describes a working MCP flow pushing Claude Design output into PenPot with reusable components. Missing for 10: official documented MCP server/API surface for Claude Design, broader independent corroboration of agent-driven write access beyond a single anecdote.
